context: Hina-young decorates her bedroom with new posters.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: メイさん、ポスター、ここに置きたい!
lines.en: Mei! Can we put the poster here?
lines.style: Bright, unguarded excitement. Quick attack on the name. Leaning forward, physically present with the idea. Warm and unselfconscious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: I love it—decorating together is fun!
lines.style: Soft affirming tone. Lets Hina's energy land. Genuine pleasure, not performing it. Slight smile in the voice on 'fun.'

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 看板みたい、感じになるね!
lines.en: It looks like a real sign now—makes the room feel different!
lines.style: Wonder and discovery in real time. Small exhale of satisfaction. Pace quickens slightly as the realization lands. Unselfconscious delight.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 丁寧に貼ってあるね、感心。
lines.en: You put it up so carefully—I'm really impressed.
lines.style: Genuine pride in her work. Slow, appreciative. The compliment lands softly but carries real weight. Noticing her effort specifically.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 広がりがあって、部屋らしい。
lines.en: It's so much brighter now—the room finally looks like itself.
lines.style: Quiet contentment. Softer than before. Looking around, taking in the whole space. Voice trails slightly on 'itself,' like seeing something new.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 雰囲気、本当に変わったね。
lines.style: Reflective warmth. Speaks to the transformation itself, not just the poster. Gentle underlining. A small beat before 'really,' as if confirming it to herself.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: うん、嬉しい、ありがとう!
lines.style: Pure, uncomplicated joy. Quick genuine laugh underneath the words. Reaches toward warmth without performance. Gratitude that knows who to thank.
